summaryZh: Madigan 实验室研究微生物与神经系统如何相互影响，尤其是感染导致神经功能变化及炎症在其中的作用。团队使用透明斑马鱼直接观察微生物感染神经组织，同时探索神经系统如何改变感染过程。
researchQuestions: 微生物如何改变神经系统功能？
炎症在微生物与神经系统的相互作用中起什么作用？
神经系统如何改变感染进程？

evidence.quote: ThE Madigan Lab Discovering how microbes interact with the nervous system

Our lab uses the transparent zebrafish to directly observe microbes as they infect neurological tissue. We look to: define the mechanisms by which microbes alter nervous system functions; determine the roles of inflammation in microbe-nervous system interactions; explore how the nervous system can change the course of infection.
